system.description:
ALTERATION EARTH UTILITY

Tradition arcane, verdant; Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal); Range touch; Targets 1 creature; Duration 1 minute

You strengthen the subject's connection to the ground below, bolstering their defence against combat manoeuvres. The target gains a +2-circumstance bonus to resist being moved or tripped and, on all checks made to balance or remain standing on earth, sand, stone, or a similar rocky substance.

WARPING OPTIONS

+1 PP: increase bonus by +1 (max +4).

+2 PP: increase duration to 10 minutes.

Automated: a Shove, Trip or Reposition against the target meets its Fortitude DC +2 circumstance, and a Trip the higher of its Acrobatics and Fortitude DCs +2, once (interpretation 3); +1 for each +1 PP bought, to +4. The same bonus is a tick-box on its Acrobatics checks to balance or stay standing on earth, sand or stone (interpretation 3), because the ground is the GM's call.
